### How to setup an SSL certificate for your Help Center's custom domain?

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677855950-generate-ssl-certificate>

Using your own domain, like docs.your-company.com, makes your help center feel more trustworthy and on-brand. Chatwoot allows you to use your own custom domain and would help you to secure your site with SSL certificates so that it's safe for your visitors.

This guide walks you through setting up a custom domain for your Help Center portal in Chatwoot.

*Note*: This guide is for Chatwoot Cloud users. If you're using the self-hosted version, you'll need to set up and manage the SSL certificate on your own.

*TLDR: Add your custom domain in Chatwoot portal settings, update your DNS with the CNAME Chatwoot provides, and we will issue the SSL certificate. Once it's ready, your Help Center will be live and accessible to your customers.*

###### Step 1: Set up your custom domain in portal settings

Log in to your Chatwoot dashboard and go to the Help Center you want to connect with your custom domain. Click on **Settings**, then scroll to the **Custom Domain** section. Click the **Add custom domain** button to begin the setup.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRUFXN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6c801bc927770584fb6c8abbc01b95baee85e110/Screenshot-202025-08-07-20at-209.45.06-E2-80-AFAM.png)

You'll now see a prompt asking for your custom domain. Enter the domain where you want your Help Center to be available (e.g., [*docs.yourdomain.com*](http://docs.yourdomain.com)). This is the website address your customers will visit to access your documentation.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRDRXN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d574d23bce04af1b4ea8afdac2f0b0968de9233a/Screenshot-202025-08-07-20at-209.45.19-E2-80-AFAM.png)

Next, you'll be shown the DNS settings you need to add so we can confirm that the domain is yours and connect it to your Help Center. You’ll need to copy this information and update your DNS provider accordingly.

If you’re not sure how to do it, you can use the option on the screen to email these details to your developer.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRDhXN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--e867de5f9f39bbe76c96a7229d271b42e46b953c/Screenshot-202025-08-07-20at-209.48.12-E2-80-AFAM.png)

###### Step 2: Update your DNS with the CNAME record

You must point your custom domain to Chatwoot by creating a CNAME record.

Host: docs  
Type: CNAME  
Value: chatwoot.help

Instructions vary by DNS provider:

###### Using Cloudflare:

You can find the setting under the "DNS" tab.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSGdrN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b9615155f7eec6919cac0af3ee486d5bc205de1d/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2011.00.10%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Note: Make sure that the SSL encryption mode is set to Full in Cloudflare (You can view this under SSL/TLS -> Overview).

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTk1uN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d8e5534c7d89148e27cf7a6fe69c9ed90b63c661/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2011.12.12%E2%80%AFAM.png)

###### Using AWS Route 53:

You can find the setting under the "Route53" service.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQ1VuN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--2f262ac957b6e041ddc8d2bf8b9178ba0f24ac63/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2011.10.00%E2%80%AFAM.png)

If you're using a different DNS provider, the steps are generally the same. Look for the DNS settings section and add a CNAME record as described. If you’re unsure how to do this, just search for instructions specific to your provider using a phrase like *How to add a CNAME record on [Your DNS Provider]*.

This step links your domain to Chatwoot’s servers. Once it’s done, we’ll have everything we need, your portal details and the domain configuration to issue the SSL certificate and make your Help Center live.

###### Step 3: Getting an SSL certificate[​](https://www.chatwoot.com/docs/product/others/help-center/#providing-ssl "Direct link to heading")

Chatwoot provides SSL certificates for all cloud customers on paid plans who set up a custom domain for their Help Center portal.

This step happens automatically. Once you add the CNAME record to your DNS, our server will verify the domain and begin issuing the SSL certificate. This usually takes just a few minutes, but in some cases, depending on your DNS provider and how long they take to update records, it may take up to 24–48 hours.

You can track the status of your SSL certificate right from the Chatwoot dashboard. Initially, you’ll see the status as **Awaiting Verification**. This means we’re still confirming your domain setup before the certificate is issued.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCR29hN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--9980ddd7b9e3b4ec32ada88668f22e0f38508fe2/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2010.22.52%E2%80%AFAM.png)

If there are any issues during the SSL verification process like an incorrect CNAME record or DNS propagation delays, you’ll see an error message next to the status on your dashboard. Hover over the status indicator to view more details about what went wrong and what you need to fix. This helps you quickly identify and resolve any problems in the setup process.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTzhhN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c9ffebe3e2f3b92a2ac5ddd8913ffebb93236e19/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2010.23.17%E2%80%AFAM.png)

Once the verification is successful and the SSL certificate is issued, the status will change to 'Live' on your dashboard. This means your Help Center is now securely available at your custom domain. Your customers can visit the URL and browse the content.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSG9iN0FFPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--05f563a7d45aac5cefa034f3f94bd890282898f7/Screenshot%202025-08-07%20at%2010.22.24%E2%80%AFAM.png)


### Embedding videos in Help Center

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1748419710-embedding-videos-in-help-center>

Chatwoot's Help Center supports automatic embedding of videos from multiple platforms. When you paste supported video URLs on their own lines (surrounded by empty lines), they will be automatically converted to embedded video players.

##### Supported Video Platforms

| Platform | URL Format | How to Get the URL |  
|----------|------------|---------------------|  
| YouTube | `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID` or `https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID` | Copy URL from browser address bar or use "Share" button |  
| Vimeo | `https://vimeo.com/VIDEO_ID` | Copy URL from browser address bar or use "Share" button |  
| Loom | `https://loom.com/share/VIDEO_ID` | Use "Share" button after recording or from video library |  
| Wistia | `https://SUBDOMAIN.wistia.com/medias/VIDEO_ID` | Copy URL from browser or use "Share & Embed" option |  
| Arcade | `https://app.arcade.software/share/VIDEO_ID` | Use "Share" button from your demo library |  
| Bunny CDN | `https://iframe.mediadelivery.net/play/LIBRARY_ID/VIDEO_ID` | Get iframe URL from Bunny CDN dashboard |  
| Direct MP4 | Any URL ending in `.mp4` | Use direct link to MP4 file from any hosting service |

##### Important Requirements

1. **Empty Lines**: Video URLs must be surrounded by empty lines (blank lines above and below)

2. **Standalone Links**: The URL must be on its own line, not embedded in other text

3. **Must be a Link:** The URL must be formatted as a clickable link in markdown (not plain text)                                        

4. **Exact Format**: URLs must match the exact patterns shown above

The video embedding system automatically detects these patterns and replaces the URLs with responsive video players that work across all devices.


### Connect analytics to your help center

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786121846-connect-analytics-to-your-help-center>

You can track how visitors use your help center by connecting your preferred analytics tools. Chatwoot supports popular providers like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Plausible, Microsoft Clarity, Meta Pixel, and Amplitude, so you can start collecting insights without adding any custom code.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTlZRSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--8b0f1d567e17046d1f48950b0475d3a305bed719/image.png?cw_image_width=667px)

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCUDFSSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--0b12d9df0527a4940ce6d2c5b64031dc445d8c83/image.png?cw_image_width=667px)

##### Before you begin

A few things to keep in mind before setting up analytics:

* Only administrators can manage analytics integrations.

* You only need to configure the providers you use. The rest can be left empty.

* Tracking scripts are added only to your public help center pages. They aren't loaded inside the Chatwoot dashboard.

##### Open the Integrations tab

1. Go to **Help Center** and open the portal you want to configure.

2. Select **Settings**.

3. Open the **Integrations** tab.

##### Add an analytics provider

Each analytics provider has its own configuration card. Enter the required ID or key, then save your changes.

1. Find the provider you want to configure.

2. Paste the required ID or key into the input field.

3. If the value isn't in the expected format, Chatwoot shows an inline validation message explaining what needs to be corrected.

4. Select **Save changes**.

If you no longer want to use a provider, simply clear the field and save again.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSlJUSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--cd54284eb8a51ff1022e12d2f1470f0f7dc223ff/image.png?cw_image_width=523px)

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRXRVSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--836e41c2ccb10995ef1200c90343f22874d02d1d/image.png?cw_image_width=522px)

##### Supported analytics providers

| Provider               | Required value | Example                 |
| ---------------------- | -------------- | ----------------------- |
| **Google Tag Manager** | Container ID   | `GTM-XXXXXXX`           |
| **Google Analytics 4** | Measurement ID | `G-XXXXXXXXXX`          |
| **Hotjar**             | Site ID        | `1234567`               |
| **Plausible**          | Domain         | `example.com`           |
| **Amplitude**          | API Key        | Your project API key    |
| **Microsoft Clarity**  | Project ID     | Your Clarity project ID |
| **Meta Pixel**         | Pixel ID       | `123456789012345`       |

##### Verify your setup

After saving your configuration, open your public help center in a new browser tab and visit a few pages.

Then check your analytics provider's real-time or debug view to confirm events are being received. For example:

* Google Analytics 4: **Realtime** report

* Meta Pixel: **Test Events**

* Microsoft Clarity: Live recordings or dashboard

* Hotjar: Incoming recordings or heatmaps

##### Notes

* Amplitude currently sends data to the default (US) region. EU data residency isn't supported yet.


### Recommend categories and articles

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786122758-recommend-categories-and-articles>

By default, your help center home page shows the first few categories and your most-viewed articles. If you want to highlight specific content instead, you can choose exactly what appears.

For each locale, you can recommend up to **3 categories** and **6 articles**, and arrange them in any order.

##### Set recommended content

1. Go to **Help Center → Locales**.

2. Click the **⋯** menu for the locale and select **Select recommended content**. 

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTzl2SGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--2b452cc1183c130205e2f5270464279411452f47/image.png?cw_image_width=717px)

3. Under **Recommended categories**, click **Add another...** and choose a category. Use the search box if needed. 

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQXB3SGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--1ffed5ac1b343e39ddd846ce2397c42d784d447b/image.png?cw_image_width=716px)

4. Under **Recommended articles**, add the articles you want to feature. 

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQzl3SGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c2c73ae92ad040331a4fd96e315a6e351a7c216d/image.png?cw_image_width=716px)

5. Drag and drop categories or articles to change their order.

6. Click **Save recommendations**. 

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSDl3SGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a9e22c699bb14f40fd99f75424357a490bbdb53e/image.png?cw_image_width=715px)


Recommendations are saved per locale, so each locale can feature different content.

##### What visitors see

Your recommended categories appear on the help center home page instead of the default category list. Recommended articles replace the **Popular articles** section with **Recommended articles**.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQnBuSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--ab0594eddb3ac0ed4feac7f3cecabb07ec13a62e/image.png?cw_image_width=718px)

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQ1JsSGdZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--db5c5de3f7aa0db25564f9ce6c826c58bd5171fa/image.png?cw_image_width=717px)

##### Good to know

* If you don't add any recommendations, the help center uses the default content.

* Categories and articles work independently. You can recommend either one or both.

* Only published articles are shown. Draft or deleted articles are skipped automatically.

* Recommended categories are shown even if they don't contain any published articles.

* Recommendations are available for every locale, including drafts.


### Hide your help center or articles from search engines

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1793050625-hide-your-help-center-or-articles-from-search-engines-f214af2c>

By default, Google and other search engines can list your help center pages in their results. You can now keep a single article, or your whole help center, out of search results. Visitors can still open and use it as before.

This is useful for pages that people should reach from your product or support conversations rather than from Google, such as internal guides, beta features or duplicate content.

##### Hide a single article

1. Go to **Help Center → Articles** and open the article.

2. Click **More properties**.

3. Turn off **Show in search results**.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRGtRUlFjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--2d061f002e40332c2dc57cdbffefaecbc8a09093/article-search-switch.png?cw_image_width=650px)

The change saves automatically. The article stays published and visible in your help center. Only search engines skip it. Each translation of an article has its own setting, so turn it off for every language you want to hide.

##### Hide your whole help center

1. Go to **Help Center → Settings**.

2. Open the **SEO** tab.

3. Turn off **Show in search results**.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSUlRUlFjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--4e7e11607dd884f84707d79db7fa7b55d740a109/help-center-seo-settings.png)

While your help center is hidden, every article's switch is turned off and can't be changed, with a note pointing back to **Settings → SEO**. Turn the help center setting back on to manage articles one by one again. 

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTXNRUlFjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f2a1dd32303c460ce8ee988b9e275c7c15a53cb3/article-switch-locked.png?cw_image_width=632px)


##### What happens when a page is hidden

* It's removed from your help center's sitemap, the list of pages that search engines read.

* Search engines are told not to list the page.

* Visitors see no change. Links, categories and help center search all work as before.

##### Good to know

* **It isn't instant.** Pages already in search results disappear the next time search engines check your help center, which can take a few days or weeks. If you need a page gone urgently, request removal in the search engine's own tools, such as Google Search Console.

* **It doesn't make pages private.** Anyone with the link can still open a hidden page. To take an article down completely, move it back to draft or archive it.

* **You can turn it back on at any time.** Pages become eligible for search results again the next time search engines check your help center.

## User Guide — Best practices


### Assigning conversations in a round-robin fashion.

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677696868-assigning-conversations-in-a-round_robin-fashion>

Chatwoot follows a round-robin auto-assignment system for conversations. This means that if there are people available (called "agents") who can respond to messages in a specific inbox, the system will divide the conversations evenly among them. If all the agents are not available, the conversations will not be assigned to anyone and will be categorized as “Unassigned”. This feature is turned on by default.

##### How to enable/disable round-robin assignments?

To enable round-robin assignments in your inbox, follow the steps below.

**Step 1.** Go to Settings → Inboxes. Click on the settings link of the inbox you want to enable round-robin assignment for.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBd2Q3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--46f6bbdfeeaee4fa4d87039fcf654f6701910da4/inbox%20settings.png)

**Step 2.** Go to the “Collaborators” tab. Find the setting for Conversation Assignment, as shown below.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBd3A3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b60b452463dee8b29c1775c73174416e848a6de0/enabling%20auto%20assignment.png)

**Step 3.** Check the box “Enable auto assignment” and click on "Update".


### Working with command bar

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677697180-working-with-command-bar>

The command bar is a key feature in Chatwoot that enhance productivity. It allows you to perform a lot of actions with just a few keystrokes. You can access the command bar using `⌘ + K` on macOS or `Ctrl + k` on Windows and Linux from anywhere on the Chatwoot dashboard.

Once opened, choose a specific page to navigate directly or select an action to perform. The command bar also offers smart action suggestions based on your current location in your dashboard. For eg: If you are looking at the command bar from conversations, it would show conversation specific actions such as snooze, resolve first.

Some of the key actions/navigation options are listed below.

##### Jumping to a page with command bar

The command bar lets you quickly navigate to a page, such as Settings, Reports, Notifications, and everything else. Start typing the page name and press Enter, and you'll be taken to that page.

###### **Quick navigations available**

* Dashboard Home

* Contacts

* Reports

  * Agent Repotrts

  * Label Reports

  * Inbox Reports

  * Team Reports

* Settings

  * Agent Settings

  * Team Settings

  * Label Settings

  * Canned Response Settings

  * Application Settings

  * Account Settings

  * Profile Settings

* Notifications

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBMnA3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d442342a7ffd476c40e7d2c4be11bf80bb99e3e8/chatwoot%20app%20navigation%20with%20command%20bar.png)

##### Performing a conversation action with command bar

The command bar is aware of where you are in the Chatwoot dashboard and recommends actions that will help you be more productive and fast. You can execute actions on a conversation like Resolve/Reopen it, Snooze it, or even assign particular agents or labels to it by simply searching for them.

###### Commands available

* Resolve/Reopen the conversation

* Mute/Unmute conversation

* Send an email transcript

* Assign a conversation to an agent

* Assign conversation to a team

* Add a label to conversation

* Snooze the conversation

**Example: Assigning an agent**

1. Open the command bar

2. Search for Assign agent and press enter

3. Select the agent you want to assign the conversation to.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBMng3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--af74613c5d2fd6cfa6a4de4a9f473b2a40feeacc/conversation%20actions%20with%20command%20bar.png)


### Working with keyboard shortcuts

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677698168-working-with-keyboard-shortcuts>

To enhance your productivity, you can work with keyboard shortcuts. These shortcuts let you perform quick actions like opening a conversation, resolving a conversation, toggling the sidebar, going to Settings, and more.

To display a list of available keyboard shortcuts, press "CMD + /" or "Win + /" on your keyboard. Or, select "Keyboard Shortcuts" from your Profile Settings menu.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBNk43VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--7307a8deb27a70bb46e46ca382052c7989570d9d/view%20keyboard%20shortcuts%20in%20chatwoot.png)

##### List of Keyboard shortcuts in Chatwoot

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBNlY3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--91be20bb204b8525fe623ad2020d3610fcaba458/List%20of%20Keyboard%20shortcuts%20in%20Chatwoot.png)


### Group your contacts into custom segments.

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677748953-group-your-contacts-using-filters-and-save-them-as-custom-segments>

With Chatwoot, you can sort and filter your contacts using different categories by using advanced filters. You can save these filtered contacts as segments, appearing in the secondary sidebar under the "Segments" section. This feature helps save different groups of contacts based on your requirements and access them readily.

##### How to create Contact Segments?

**Step 1.** Start by filtering your contacts. Select "Contacts" from your sidebar and click the "Filter" button.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBNUdLVHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--39349fca2dc2b6b58f09651edf54e5c438ff805d/filtering%20contacts%20in%20chatwoot.png)

**Step 2.** A modal will pop up, which lets you select the filter type, the operator (equal to, not equal to, contains, does not contain), and the value. You can join multiple filters together. Here is an example:

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBNVNLVHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c5c2b5afda1f9d196f9da25fdf872610f1342bda/contact%20filters%20example.png)

Click the "Submit" button to apply the filter to your contacts.

**Step 3.** You will now be able to see a "**Save filter**" button in the header of the contact page. Click on it. A modal will pop up, asking *Do you want to save this filter?*. Give a name for your filter and click the "**Save filter"** button. 

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBN0dLVHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--e8123c251987628d200ab010e1d3c11d36f463cd/saving%20a%20filter%20in%20chatwoot.png)

Your segment has been created.

##### How to view a saved Contact Segment?

You will be able to find your saved segment in the secondary sidebar. You can click on it anytime to quickly view the contact group.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBOEdLVHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6d27b3194256cf54377e61cbe77aca289834c9f9/contact%20segment%20example.png)

##### How to delete a saved segment?

To delete a Contact Segment, open it and select the "Delete Filter" option from the header.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBK2FLVHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a25de37af08b30b9911f296544b19b7c12dc3c13/deleting%20a%20contact%20segment.png)

Confirm deletion.


### Group chats with filters, save as folders

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677698771-group-chats-with-filters-save-as-folders>

You can organize and sort your conversations using advanced filters and save them as folders. These folders show up in the sidebar for quick access to specific conversations within the user's view.

To use this feature, follow the following steps.

**Step 1.** Click on the filter icon at the top of the message list.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBOVo3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--59eb002e5ee8a7c38566db096c3ed02c05c45c8d/message%20filter.png)

**Step 2.** A modal will open up, which lets you select the filter type, the operator (equal to, not equal to, present, not present) and the value. Select and apply your filters.

**Step 3.** After applying the filter, you will see all the qualifying conversations. Next, click on the “**Save” button** at the top of the conversation list panel.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBOXA3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--62448c33ba89725fbca75d9df67340310453e9b5/save%20message%20filter.png)

**Step 4.** A modal will open up asking you to name the filter.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBOTE3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6b7483dbd0fc95c022ab540855b73ddfdc768357/saving%20a%20filter%20as%20a%20conversation%20folder.png)

Your saved filter will now appear as a folder on sidebar. Here is an example:

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBOTU3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b1928ab71eadb4eb28b00176ae2b5242a5d610d7/conversation%20folders%20in%20chatwoot.png)

You can access this readily whenever you want to.

###### How to delete a folder?

To delete a folder, click the red bin icon, as indicated in the following screenshot. To confirm, click on the “**Yes, Delete”** button.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBK0I3VHc9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f8f7d62157da1899fec30a9d32efc3a89f5501ed/deleting%20a%20conversation%20folder.png)

## User Guide — Captain


### Get started with Captain AI

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101283-captain-_-introduction>

Captain is Chatwoot's AI. It can answer customers for you, help your agents write replies, and learn from your help docs and past conversations.

###### What Captain can do

| Capability                           | What it does                                                                                                                                    | Who uses it                 | Page                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Assistant                            | Replies to customers in the inboxes you connect, and hands off to your team when it cannot help                                                 | Customers                   | [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain)            |
| Knowledge                            | Learns from website pages, PDFs and FAQs you add                                                                                                | Admins                      | [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain)                               |
| Guardrails, guidelines and scenarios | Controls what the assistant answers, how it sounds, and what it does in specific situations                                                     | Admins                      | [Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios)            |
| Audience and schedule                | Limits which customers the assistant replies to, and when                                                                                       | Admins                      | [Control who Captain replies to and when](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule) |
| Custom tools                         | Lets the assistant look things up in your own systems, such as order status                                                                     | Admins                      | [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain)                      |
| Copilot                              | Helps agents summarize, draft replies and look things up while they work                                                                        | Agents                      | [Work faster with Captain Copilot](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738110272-how-to-use-captain-copilot)                                       |
| Memories                             | Saves key customer details as contact notes for next time                                                                                       | Assistant                   | [Use Captain Memories](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101691-how-to-use-captain-memories)                                                  |
| AI help in the editor and inbox      | Rephrase, summarize and suggest reply in the editor, audio transcription, and **Suggest with Captain** for a conversation's labels and priority | Agents; admins turn them on |                                                                                                                                                              |
| Captain conditions in automation     | An automation rule can ask Captain whether a conversation matches a description you write, for example "customer wants to cancel"               | Admins                      |                                                                                                                                                              |
| Auto-translate                       | Shows customer messages in each agent's language and sends agent replies in the customer's language                                             |  Agents; admins turn it on  | [How to auto-translate messages in a conversation?](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1792447465-auto_translate-conversations)                 |

###### Plan & access

| Plan          | Captain                                                   |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Hacker (free) | Not included                                              |
| Startups      | Included, with monthly AI credits                         |
| Business      | Included, with more monthly AI credits. Adds custom tools |
| Enterprise    | Included, with the most monthly AI credits                |

* Credit amounts per plan and the top-up price are on [Pricing & Plans > Captain AI credits.](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) How credits are used is on [Captain AI credits and usage.](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain)

* Role: only administrators can create or change assistants, documents, FAQs and tools. Agents can view assistants, try them in the Playground, review FAQ suggestions, and use Copilot.

* Self-hosted: Captain is included in the Premium and Enterprise self-hosted plans, with your own OpenAI key. See [Enable Captain on self-hosted.](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1755284287-how-to-enable-captain-on-self_hosted-installations)

* Free trial: Captain is not available during the free trial.

###### How to check you have it

Look for **Captain** in the left sidebar. If you click it and see **Upgrade to use Captain AI**, your account is on the Hacker plan. An administrator can upgrade from **Billing**.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSEEwRWdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--731e9f1faae8605e5b120848cc4ddece72702f48/c1-sidebar.png)

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSW8wRWdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--7e35e572a82f2aa5c121fefae268135136b7e443/c2-paywall.png)

##### 

##### Set up & try

The usual order:

1. [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain), then test it in the **Playground**.

2. [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain) so it knows your product.

3. Optional: [Control who Captain replies to and when](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule),[Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios), [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain).

Self-hosted admins start with [Enable Captain on self-hosted](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1755284287-how-to-enable-captain-on-self_hosted-installations).

##### Get value

* Keep knowledge current: review **FAQ suggestions** every week. See [Add FAQs and review FAQ suggestions in Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101609-creating-an-faq-with-captain)

* Watch the assistant's **Overview** for **Knowledge coverage** and how many conversations it handled.

* Hand a conversation to the assistant yourself: pick it in the conversation's assignee dropdown. See \
  [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain)

* Check credit usage in **Billing**. See [Captain AI credits and usage](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain).

###### What changes in other features when Captain is on

* Website live chat: the "we are away" message is not shown while the assistant is answering.

* Continue conversations by email: the email prompt is not shown unless the assistant hands off.

* Inbox greeting: the inbox's greeting message is not sent while the assistant is handling the conversation. If the assistant replies to everyone (audience set to **Everyone**), customers in its inboxes do not see the greeting.

* Lesson 5 in Start here walks through Captain end to end. See [Lesson 5: AI actions.](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1777328078-lesson-5-ai-actions)

##### Troubleshoot

If Captain is not replying, giving wrong answers, or not learning, go to [Troubleshoot Captain.](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain)


### Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain>

##### Discover

An assistant answers customers in the inboxes you connect it to, and hands the conversation to your team when it cannot help.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators create, edit and delete assistants. Agents can view them and use the **Playground**. Each inbox can have one assistant.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* At least one inbox to connect (live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, email and others).

* Some knowledge to add straight after: website pages, PDFs or FAQs. Without knowledge the assistant has little to answer from.

* Captain credits: every assistant reply to a customer uses credits.

###### 1. Create the assistant

1. Go to **Captain** > **Assistants**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTmx1RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--4ff1d7396a395763cb43e9937266621030d48376/captain-2-s1-1-captain.png?cw_image_width=688px)

2. Start the new assistant:

   * No assistant yet: click **Create a new assistant** on the empty page.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRmx4RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d424ef07718d3b5653ccb4f076da878fd3f10a7f/captain-2-s1-2a-empty.png?cw_image_width=674px)

   * You already have an assistant: open the assistant switcher next to the assistant's name and click **Create Assistant**.

3. Fill in: **Name**, **Description** and **Product Name** are required. Description can be up to 500 characters.

   * **Name**: an internal name, for example "Support assistant".

   * **Description**: what the assistant is for. Write a purpose, not instructions.

   * **Product Name**: the product it supports. It uses this when it talks about your product. Captain only answers questions about the product you name here, so use your brand or product name, not one narrow feature.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCUFZ4RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a6011809ee9d2a04f978ef1a8f557fea1a5243b4/captain-2-s1-3-fill-in.png?cw_image_width=438px)

4. Choose features (all start off):

   * **Generate FAQs from resolved conversations**: Captain suggests new FAQs from resolved conversations. See [Add FAQs and review FAQ suggestions in Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101609-creating-an-faq-with-captain).

   * **Capture key details as memories from customer interactions.** See [Use Captain Memories](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101691-how-to-use-captain-memories).

   * **Include source citations in responses**: the reply shows which document it used.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTUJ5RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--34fe30acb811e32bf440e37e828ce0a74795b15f/captain-2-s1-4-features.png?cw_image_width=407px)

5. Click **Create**.

   * If this is your first assistant, Chatwoot opens its **FAQs**.

   * If you used the switcher, Chatwoot stays on the assistant you were viewing. Select the new assistant in the switcher before the next step.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRjV6RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--adf50282834f63bddc4d8dadb23b580756854093/captain-2-s1-5-created.png?cw_image_width=655px)

###### 2. Connect an inbox

1. Select the new assistant in the assistant switcher, then go to **Inboxes**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRmQwRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--ac53d9e2cf04383b495e0b0569ad105e2961adc4/captain-2-s2-1-inboxes.png)

2. Click **Connect a new inbox**, choose the inbox, and confirm.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCT3QwRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d6b0595e467e8a3761f452727c8b82a3d795989b/captain-2-s2-2-connect-dialog.png?cw_image_width=475px)

   \
   Until an inbox is connected, the assistant's **Overview** shows: "This assistant isn't connected to any inbox yet, so it won't respond to conversations."

###### 3. Set what it says and when it closes

Open the assistant's **Settings**.

* **Basic settings**: turn on **Allow access to contact information** if the assistant should use the contact's details when replying.

  ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCUGQxRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b3142c7074b7810526549afd80a6bdf1a2d06b18/captain-2-s3-1-basic-settings.png?cw_image_width=703px)

* **System settings**:

  * **Handoff message**: what the assistant says when it passes the conversation to your team.

  * **When customers stop replying**: choose the **Action when the customer stops replying** and how long to wait (5 minutes to 24 hours; the default is 60 minutes).

    * **Let Captain review it (recommended)**: Captain decides whether to resolve or hand off. This is the default.

    * **Always resolve**: Captain resolves every conversation after the wait.

    * **Wait for the customer**: Captain never resolves on its own. It can still hand off if the customer asks.

  * **Send a message when resolving** (on by default) sends the **Resolution Message** before Captain resolves.

    ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTzEyRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--7142581d0998204c8f5c8d8819cabf6b7191fc06/captain-2-s3-2-system-settings.png?cw_image_width=614px)

###### Test it

1. Open the assistant and go to **Playground**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCR2QzRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--bfd2b1d6e86d3b21c0dd72e36b5b2acacddef78d/captain-2-t1-playground.png?cw_image_width=642px)

2. Ask the questions your customers ask most. Check the answers are accurate, short and in your tone.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTzUzRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--da31915d57d12a37fc2e667baa29f98b4d07c127/captain-2-t2-sample-answer.png?cw_image_width=633px)

3. Ask something it should not know. Check it says it cannot help and offers to connect you with your team. It hands off when you accept.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSUo0RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--7fab90a2e880967e8fc5f140921840671989bd86/captain-2-t3-handoff.png?cw_image_width=658px)

4. The reply can take a few seconds to appear; you can keep the page open while it works.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTFI0RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6035131705f4b3e362dbe6fdbfaf73cfaa321377/captain-2-t4-waiting.png?cw_image_width=657px)

5. Then send a real message to the connected inbox, for example from your website widget, and watch the reply arrive.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCUEo0RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--74234b9c339e16674130bac1a7d40ecf8e81cec9/captain-2-t5-real-conversation.png?cw_image_width=661px)

Playground messages use credits, the same as replies to customers.

###### Try changes before you save them

In the **Playground**, open **Test setup** to try changes without touching the assistant. Changes apply only to this playground session unless you save them.

* **Knowledge**: paste text into **Reference text** to test an answer before it is a document. Click **Add document permanently** to keep it.

* **Scenarios**, **Guidelines** and **Guardrails**: add a temporary item with **Add to test (↵)**, or use **Include in this test** to switch saved ones on or off for this test. Click **Add scenario permanently**, **Add guideline permanently** or **Add guardrail permanently** to keep one.

  ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTUo1RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--743384d5138727148ddd8f7a61b838e51e888814/captain-2-p1-test-setup.png?cw_image_width=695px)

* Under each reply, **Run details** shows the scenarios and rules used, tool calls and any handoffs.

  ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRnQ2RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a79b9e673a65dd5265863cd39f6ab7101379ce9c/captain-2-p2-run-details.png?cw_image_width=671px)

* **Reset test setup** clears everything temporary.

##### Get value

* Add knowledge next: [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain).

* Decide who it replies to and when: [Control who Captain replies to and when](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule).

* Shape its answers: [Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios).

* Check the assistant's **Overview** for conversations handled, **Knowledge coverage** and a **Captain summary**.

* Hand a conversation to the assistant yourself: in the conversation's assignee dropdown, choose the assistant (only the assistant connected to that inbox is listed). The conversation moves to pending and the assistant takes over, even if the audience or schedule rules would have skipped it. To take it back, assign it to a person.

* Use the assistant switcher (**Switch between assistants**) if you run several, for example one per brand or language.

* The assistant reads the conversation's earlier public messages, including ones sent before it was connected. It never sees private notes.

* To see how the assistant is doing, use its **Overview**. See [Captain Overview and reports](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891433-captain-overview-and-reports).

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                               | Likely cause                       | What to do                                                |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Assistant never replies                               | No inbox connected                 | Connect one in **Inboxes**                                |
| Cannot connect an inbox                               | The inbox already has an assistant | Disconnect it from the other assistant first              |
| Replies are vague or wrong                            | Little or no knowledge added       | Add documents and FAQs, then test again in the Playground |
| Cannot see Create a new assistant or Create Assistant | You are not an administrator       | Ask an administrator                                      |

More causes, including silent ones: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Add documents to Captain's knowledge

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain>

##### Discover

Documents teach your assistant about your product. Add website pages or PDF files, and Captain reads them, answers from them, and creates FAQs from them.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators add, refresh and delete documents. Every paid plan includes up to 2,000 documents. The limit is shared by all assistants in the account, and each PDF or crawled web page counts as one document.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

* Website pages must be public. Captain cannot read pages behind a login.

* PDFs must be 10MB or smaller and contain real text (scanned images may not be readable).

* If your website blocks crawlers in robots.txt, allow Chatwoot first (below).

###### Add a website or PDF

1. Go to **Captain** > **Documents**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTE44RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f2fc1c0bbf59110d3cb1e8acee39b541cf50587b/captain-3-s1-documents.png?cw_image_width=623px)

2. Click **Create a new document**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRUo5RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--78a6533345e7c14bb8e9ee3689427a538d0486bf/captain-3-s2-create-dialog.png?cw_image_width=634px)

3. Choose the **Document Type**:

   * **URL**: enter the page address. Captain reads that page and the pages linked under the same path. For example, `https://example.com/help` covers every page that starts with that address.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSjE5RmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--60fe3394c32df151b71ada9b1ac5103a6307e4eb/captain-3-s3-url.png?cw_image_width=610px)

     * **PDF File**: click **Choose PDF file** and pick the file.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQXArRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--def5a5e675ba6d9617d8d0a910bd91cae103177f/captain-3-s3-pdf-option.png?cw_image_width=610px)

4. Optional: add a **Document Name (Optional)**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSjUrRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--5a6e1982ae01452ce6a7b6ee5b2facaa7c980350/captain-3-s4-name.png?cw_image_width=646px)

5. Choose the assistant and click **Create**.

Captain reads and indexes the content. Pages it finds while crawling are added as separate documents.

###### Allow Chatwoot to crawl your site

Chatwoot uses Firecrawl to read websites, and it follows your robots.txt. If some pages are blocked, add this to `https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt`:

```
User-agent: FirecrawlAgent
Allow: /
```

Check the file is live at that address, then add or refresh the document.

If your robots.txt blocks the crawler when you add a website, no pages are added and no error is shown. The assistant then gives incomplete or generic answers.

###### Test it

1. Open the document's menu and choose **View details**.

2. Check **Crawled content** (or **PDF details**) shows your text, and **Related FAQs** lists sensible questions.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTEovRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--bf8ae620ef4f9e6dd959ce3da5e8665ae7ad00de/captain-3-t2-details.png?cw_image_width=646px)

3. Ask a question from that page in the assistant's **Playground**.

##### Get value

* Keep documents current: use **Refresh now** on one document, or select several and click **Refresh**. The list shows when each was last updated.

  ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQU9CRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d6323537b00eff490aa8a5925981b01b57c62c0a/captain-3-t1-menu.png?cw_image_width=651px)

* Website documents also refresh automatically: monthly on Startups (on the 1st), weekly on Business (on Sundays) and daily on Enterprise. Processing can take longer, so a page may not refresh at that exact time. Uploaded PDFs are not refreshed automatically.

* One website crawl adds up to 500 pages, and never more than your remaining document allowance.

* Prefer focused sources, such as your help center, over a whole marketing site.

* **Used in conversations** shows which conversations used a document.

* Deleting a document removes everything Captain learned from it.

* Help Center articles are not read automatically. To use them, add your Help Center's address as a URL document. Each language version of an article is a separate page, so each counts as a document.

* FAQs created from a document go live straight away. They are listed under **FAQs** and need no approval.

* FAQs that Captain generates are always in your account's language. The assistant still replies in the customer's language.

* Captain does not remove personal or confidential details from what you add. Only add content you are happy for the assistant to quote to customers.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                                     | Likely cause                                                                 | What to do                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Status shows **Failed to sync** with **Access denied**      | The page needs a login, or your site blocked the request (error 401 or 403). | Make the page public, or allow the request on your site.                                        |
| Added a website but no pages appear, or answers are generic | Your robots.txt may block the crawler.                                       | Allow it as shown in **Allow Chatwoot to crawl your site**, then add the document again.        |
| **Page not found**                                          | URL is wrong or the page moved                                               | Fix the URL and add it again                                                                    |
| **Page took too long to respond**                           | Your site was slow                                                           | Use **Retry refresh** later                                                                     |
| **Page returned empty content**                             | Content loads only with scripts, or the page is empty                        | Use a page with plain text, or upload a PDF                                                     |
| **update stalled**                                          | A refresh did not finish                                                     | Use **Retry refresh**                                                                           |
| PDF details says readable content could not be extracted    | Scanned or image-only PDF                                                    | Upload a text PDF                                                                               |
| Banner: Document limit reached                              | The account has 2,000 documents across all its assistants                    | Delete documents you no longer need, or see [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) |

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSkdCRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f19b92a3bb4426eded2e3c05648a9d8f3247efe2/captain-3-f1-failed-sync.png?cw_image_width=723px)

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Add FAQs and review FAQ suggestions in Captain

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101609-creating-an-faq-with-captain>

##### Discover

FAQs are question and answer pairs your assistant uses to reply. You can write them yourself, and Captain suggests new ones from your documents and from questions customers keep asking.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators write and edit FAQs. Anyone can review FAQ suggestions; agents see only suggestions from conversations they can access.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant with some documents. See [Add documents to Captain's knowledge.](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain)

* For suggestions from conversations, turn on **Generate FAQs from resolved conversations** in the assistant. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain)

###### Write an FAQ

1. Go to **Captain** > **FAQs**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSWlnRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--97e8dc0b533a0df4cf993960f7f47344658a1f58/captain-4-w1-faqs.png)

2. Click **Create new FAQ**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTStnRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f149ad69d9f6e19c29de48021f3353edae8599f5/captain-4-w2-create.png)

3. Enter the question and the answer, choose the assistant, and click **Create**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCREtoRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--bc0326bcf4481bceaa3c7a263b41d7228a9b1f91/captain-4-w3-filled.png)

###### Review FAQ suggestions

Captain groups recurring customer questions into suggestions and ranks them by customer demand. Suggestions are written in your account's language. Suggestions only come from resolved conversations where an agent replied. Conversations Captain handles on its own do not create suggestions.

1. Go to **Captain** > **FAQs** and click **Review suggestions** (or open **FAQ suggestions**).

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSTJoRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--116c7ec3193d343d234bc23df957ef039e2c12ac/captain-4-r1-suggestions.png)

2. Open a suggestion. **Source conversations** shows the conversations behind it.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTFdoRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--681b5219ba7cac69c4c6e9873f9c7db64dee686e/captain-4-r2-review-sources.png)

3. Edit the question or answer if needed and click **Save changes**.

4. Click **Approve** to add it to Captain's knowledge, or **Dismiss** to drop it.

FAQs Captain generates from a document are listed under that document's **Related FAQs**. FAQs created from your documents go live straight away and need no approval.

###### Test it

Ask the approved question in the assistant's **Playground** and check it uses your answer.

##### Get value

* Review suggestions weekly. They come from real customer questions, so they fill the gaps that matter most.

* Keep answers short and specific. One question per FAQ.

* The assistant's **Overview** shows **Knowledge coverage**: approved FAQs against suggestions waiting for review. A banner appears when suggestions are ready.

* Search with **Search FAQs...**, and select several to delete at once.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                            | Likely cause                                                                                                                                                                                     | What to do                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| No suggestions ever appear                         | **Generate FAQs from resolved conversations** is off, or few conversations have been resolved yet. Or no agent replied in the resolved conversations. Suggestions need at least one agent reply. | Turn it on in the assistant and give it time         |
| Assistant still gives the old answer               | The FAQ is a suggestion, not approved                                                                                                                                                            | Approve it                                           |
| Cannot create or edit an FAQ                       | You are not an administrator                                                                                                                                                                     | Ask an administrator, or approve suggestions instead |
| An agent sees fewer suggestions than an admin      | Agents see only suggestions from conversations they can access                                                                                                                                   | Expected                                             |
| **No accessible source conversations were found.** | The conversations are in inboxes you cannot see, or were deleted                                                                                                                                 | Ask an administrator with access to review it        |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios>

##### Discover

Three sets of rules shape your assistant: **Guardrails** decide which questions it answers, **Response Guidelines** decide how its replies sound, and **Scenarios** tell it what to do in specific situations.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators edit them. They are part of every Captain account, on every paid plan.

| Rule set            | Use it for                                                           | Example                                                                                                            |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Guardrails          | Keeping the assistant on topic and away from off-limits questions    | "Do not give legal or medical advice."                                                                             |
| Response Guidelines | Tone, length and structure of replies                                | "Keep replies under three sentences. Be friendly, not formal."                                                     |
| Scenarios           | Step-by-step handling of a situation, optionally using a custom tool | "When a customer asks for a refund, ask for the order number, check it with the order lookup tool, then hand off." |

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

* For scenarios that call your systems, a custom tool. See [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-\_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain).

###### Add guardrails and response guidelines

1. Go to **Captain**, open the assistant, and go to **Settings**.

2. Open **Guardrails** or **Response guidelines**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQnFGRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--cee8d94c07192eb0fa56e36c057018d140204eaa/captain-5-g1-guardrails.png?cw_image_width=695px)

3. Click **Add a guardrail** or **Add a response guideline**, type the rule as one short sentence, and click **Create**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCR2FGRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--1261f9513960ae14caf5d9521dbab040d9236889/captain-5-g3-add-guardrail.png?cw_image_width=699px)

4. To add rules from the examples, type in the box under the examples and click **Add and save (↵)**, or press Enter.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSmVGRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--959794de274686c31cbfef33beed98c5464a60ad/captain-5-g2-guidelines.png?cw_image_width=707px)

5. To change a rule, click its pencil icon, edit the text, and press Enter.

###### Add a scenario

1. Go to **Captain**, open the assistant, and go to **Scenarios**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTU9GRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--58128ee5ffaf9b61364d0f6d4ee4bbef7e45168d/captain-5-s1-scenarios.png?cw_image_width=729px)

2. Click **Add a scenario** and fill in:

   * **Title**: a short name, for example "Refund request".

   * **Description**: when this scenario applies.

   * **How to handle**: what the assistant should do, in plain steps. To use a tool in a step, type **@** and pick it from the list, for example **Handoff to Human** or one of your custom tools. If the scenario should end with your team, add the handoff as the last step.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRXVHRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--569cf0d90272fc8d2b6a747fb21883c48f72c60d/captain-5-s2-add-scenario.png?cw_image_width=527px)

3. Click **Create**.

4. To change a scenario, open it, edit the fields, and click **Update changes**.

###### Test it

In the **Playground**, ask one question each rule should catch (for example an off-topic question, and a refund request). Check the reply follows the rule.

##### Get value

* Start small: three to five guardrails and guidelines. Add more when you see a real problem in conversations.

* Write rules as instructions to a new team member, not keywords.

* Guardrails are instructions to the AI, not a filter. They make off-topic answers much less likely but cannot rule them out, so keep the **Handoff message** clear.

* If a tool used in a scenario is disabled, that scenario may stop working. Chatwoot warns you before you disable it.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                 | Likely cause                                                                              | What to do                                          |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Assistant ignores a rule                | The rule is vague or conflicts with another                                               | Rewrite it as one clear sentence; remove conflicts  |
| Scenario never runs                     | The situation description does not match how customers ask                                | Describe the situation in customers' own words      |
| Scenario stops halfway                  | Its custom tool is disabled or failing                                                    | Check the tool in **Tools**                         |
| No **Scenarios** item for the assistant | Account is on Hacker (free), or, on self-hosted, Captain is not turned on for the account | Upgrade, or ask your Super Admin to turn on Captain |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Control who Captain replies to and when

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule>

##### Discover

You can choose which customers the assistant replies to (**Audience**) and when (**Schedule**). Conversations the assistant does not pick up stay **Open** for your team. Audience and Schedule belong to the assistant, so they apply to every inbox it is connected to.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise : [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators change these settings.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant connected to an inbox. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

* For a schedule, business hours turned on for that inbox, in the inbox's own settings. See [Business Hours and Auto-Responder](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1777421876-business-hours-and-auto_responder).

* For audience rules on your own data, the contact custom attributes you want to use. See [Understanding Contacts](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1677498364-understanding-contacts).

###### Choose the audience

1. Go to **Captain** > **Assistants**, open the assistant, and go to **Settings** > **Audience**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQldKRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--df168011f606d921951ec0f354e341e9d927ccab/captain-6-a1-audience.png?cw_image_width=704px)

2. Choose:

   * **Everyone**: the assistant replies in every conversation in its inboxes. This is the default.

   * **Specific audience**: the assistant replies only to customers who match your conditions.

3. For a specific audience, add conditions. Each has an attribute, an operator and a value.

   * Contact attributes: Name, Email, Phone, Identifier, Country, City, Company, Created at, Last activity, Blocked, Labels.

   * Conversation attributes: Logged-in user, Browser language. Browser language comes from the website widget only, so it does not work for WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS or other channels. **Labels** means contact labels, not conversation labels. **Logged-in user** means the visitor was verified with identity validation (HMAC) in your website widget.

   * Your contact custom attributes.

   * The operators you can pick depend on the attribute. For example, **Name** offers only equal and not equal, **Email** also offers contains (use it to target a domain such as `@acme.com`), and dates offer greater than, less than and days before.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSWlKRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c16601bc4f6c444499f57b145199adb124abed4e/captain-6-a2b-conditions.png?cw_image_width=653px)

4. Choose whether customers must match all conditions or any of them. You can group conditions, for example "Plan is Pro AND (Country is US OR Country is Canada)". You can nest groups one level deep: a group can contain sub-groups, but a sub-group cannot contain another group.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTDJKRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--09933ceb8cdb3564f8bb653896ebe84fe00ed775/captain-6-a3-grouped.png?cw_image_width=612px)

5. Save.

###### Choose the schedule

1. In the same **Settings**, open **Schedule**.

2. Choose **Anytime** (default), **During business hours**, or **Outside business hours**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCT3FKRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--adecad4ef39b9588cbff4968b7533cccd5939845/captain-6-h1-schedule.png?cw_image_width=641px)

3. Save.

Both rules must pass: the assistant replies only when the customer is in the audience and it is inside the schedule.

###### Test it

1. Start a new conversation as a customer who matches, inside the schedule. The assistant replies.

2. Start one as a customer who does not match. It goes to your team with no assistant reply.

##### Get value

* Common setups: assistant only outside business hours; assistant only for logged-in website users; assistant for everyone except customers with a "VIP" label.

* The rules are checked when a conversation starts or a resolved one reopens, not on every message. Once the assistant is in a conversation it stays until the conversation is resolved or handed off. Changes apply to new and reopened conversations only.

* Text matching ignores case. Phone numbers match with or without the leading +. A checkbox attribute that was never set counts as unchecked.

* The schedule follows the inbox's business hours and their time zone. If the time zone is wrong, the assistant can be off for most of your customers' day, with no warning.

* These rules decide when the assistant joins on its own. An agent can still hand any conversation to the assistant from the assignee dropdown, and that ignores audience and schedule. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                               | Likely cause                                                                                  | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Assistant replies to someone you excluded             | The contact's details changed after the conversation started                                  | Expected. The rule applies from the next new or reopened conversation. Open the contact and check its attributes in the sidebar. Captain checks the values the contact had when the conversation started. |
| Assistant is in a conversation it should have skipped | An agent assigned the conversation to the assistant                                           | Expected. Manual assignment ignores audience and schedule                                                                                                                                                 |
| Schedule has no effect                                | Business hours are off for that inbox. Inboxes without business hours count as always covered | Turn on business hours in the inbox settings                                                                                                                                                              |
| Your attribute is not in the list                     | It is a conversation custom attribute. Only contact custom attributes work                    | Use a contact attribute instead. Create it in **Settings › Custom attributes** and choose **Contact**.                                                                                                    |
| Cannot save the audience                              | A condition has no value (highlighted in red), or Specific audience has no conditions         | Complete or remove the condition. **Is present** and **Is not present** (date attributes only) need no value.                                                                                             |
| Assistant is silent for everyone                      | Audience or schedule excludes them                                                            | Check both settings, then [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain)                                                                            |


### Set up custom tools for Captain

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain>

##### Discover

Custom tools let the assistant call your own systems during a conversation, for example to check an order, a warranty or a booking, instead of handing off.

Plan & access: Business or Enterprise ([Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing)). On Startups, **Tools** usually shows **Upgrade to use tools with Captain**. Each assistant has its own list of tools. Administrators create tools, and only administrators can see the saved credentials. Self-hosted: the Super Admin turns on **Custom Tools** for the account.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSHlMRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b3ad68c7aa680030f25abcc85675bca08ae18ba1/captain-7-t1-tools.png?cw_image_width=711px)

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An HTTPS endpoint on a public hostname. Chatwoot blocks plain HTTP, IP addresses, localhost, private networks and .local addresses.

* The endpoint must accept the connection within 2 seconds and answer within 20 seconds, with a response of 1 MB or less.

* Its credentials, if it needs any.

###### Create a tool

1. Go to **Captain** > **Tools** and click **Create a new tool**. First use the assistant switcher at the top to choose the assistant the tool is for. The form opens in a side panel.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQVNNRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--0573b661ea57afdb4fc5eba577e5cfd5c04d29fb/captain-7-t1-tools.png?cw_image_width=619px)

2. Fill in:

   * **Tool Name**: short, for example "Order Lookup" (55 characters or fewer).
