   * **Description**: when the assistant should use it, written like a briefing for a new agent. This decides whether the assistant picks the tool.

   * **Method**: GET to read data; POST, PUT or PATCH to send or change data; DELETE to remove something.

   * **Endpoint URL**: use `{{ parameter_name }}` for values the assistant fills in, for example `https://api.example.com/orders/``{{ order_id }}`.

   * **Authentication Type**: **None**, **Bearer Token**, **Basic Auth**, or **API Key** (with **Header Name** and **Header Value**). Use this for credentials.

   * **Headers**: click **Add Header** for fixed headers your API needs on every call, such as an API version or tenant ID (up to 16). Values are sent exactly as typed. Chatwoot sets Authorization, Host, Content-Length, Content-Type and any header starting with X-Chatwoot itself, so you cannot add those.

   * **Parameters**: click **Add Parameter** for each value the assistant should get from the customer. Give a name, type, description, and mark **Required** if needed.

   * **Add verified email**: adds a parameter. Chatwoot puts the email that the customer verified with a one-time code in this parameter. In customer conversations, Captain cannot see or change it. Use this parameter when your API finds the customer by email, for example `https://api.example.com/orders?email={{ email }}`. A tool can have one verified email parameter.

   * **Require email verification**: Captain can use the tool only after the customer verifies their email with a one-time code. If the tool has a verified email parameter, this setting is always on.

   * **Request Body Template (Optional)**: for POST, PUT or PATCH. This and the response template are under **Templates**. The request template is a JSON body. It supports Liquid, for example `{{ order_id }}` for a parameter.

   * **Response Template (Optional)**: pick out the fields the assistant needs, for example `Order {{ response.order_id }} status: {{ response.status }}`. Read the API reply through `response`, for example `{{ response.status }}`. Leave the template blank to send Captain the raw JSON.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSGVNRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6c55d48e35370d7d80740368ed50707e01641bcd/captain-7-t2-create-panel.png?cw_image_width=647px)

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCS09NRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--73b27cafc10ad7fca9966b180773bf8baae8874a/captain-7-t2b-filled-form.png?cw_image_width=411px)

3. Click **Test connection**, then **Create**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRUdORmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f4436b3a051760b822131068857ee53879c11bf5/captain-7-t3-test-connection.png?cw_image_width=571px)

**Test connection** works only for endpoints without templates or a request body. For others, test in the Playground. A green result means your endpoint returned a 2xx status: it is reachable and accepted the credentials.

###### Test it

Ask a question in the **Playground** that needs the tool, for example "Where is order 1234?". Check the reply uses real data.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCS1NORmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d2fc005efeb5db89db450a3135112c9e52183235/captain-7-p1-playground-tool.png?cw_image_width=738px)

###### Protect customer data

A customer can type any email into the widget or the pre-chat form. Some tools return or change the data of one customer, such as orders, invoices or bookings. Turn on email verification for these tools.

When Captain calls one of these tools, it asks the customer for their email. Chatwoot sends a 6-digit code to that email, and the customer types it in the conversation. The tool runs only after Chatwoot checks that the code is correct.

* A verification applies to one conversation only. It lasts up to 1 hour, or up to 3 hours in email conversations. A new conversation starts without verification.

* A code expires after 30 minutes. The customer can try a code 5 times. Chatwoot sends a customer a maximum of 5 codes in one hour.

* **Require email verification** does not control which email the tool sends. If your API gets the email from a normal parameter, Captain can send any email. To make the tool send only the verified email, use **Add verified email**.

* Chatwoot can find signs that a tool uses customer data. If it finds them and the tool has no email verification, Chatwoot shows **Save without email verification?** before it saves. Click **Go back** or **Save anyway**.

* In the Playground and in reply suggestions, the user is a team member. Captain fills the verified email parameter. The result tells you if Chatwoot verified that email.

* On installed toolsets, administrators can turn **Require email verification** on or off.

##### Get value

* Custom tools work best for lookups with clear inputs, such as an order status, a booking or a record by ID.

* Each assistant can have up to 50 tools. Keep the list short anyway: with many tools the assistant is more likely to pick the wrong one.

* Adding, editing, turning off or deleting a tool changes it only for the assistant you are viewing. Tools that existed before tools became per-assistant were copied to every assistant, so check each one.

* Running several assistants? Give each only the tools it needs.

* Turn a tool off with its toggle instead of deleting it. If a scenario uses it, Chatwoot warns you first. See [Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios).

* Chatwoot sends headers with each request. The headers tell your system the account, conversation, contact, assistant and inbox.

  * `X-Chatwoot-Verified-Email` contains the email that the customer verified with a one-time code. If the customer did not verify, Chatwoot does not send this header.

  * `X-Chatwoot-Contact-Email` contains the email on the contact record. Anyone can type this email. Do not use it to return private data.

  * `X-Chatwoot-Contact-Inbox-Verified` is `true` when identity validation (HMAC) verified the contact. This header does not verify the email.

  If your system returns private data, check `X-Chatwoot-Verified-Email`, or turn on email verification for the tool. See [How to enable identity validation in Chatwoot?](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677587479-how-to-enable-identity-validation-in-chatwoot).

* If your API returns text written by customers, return only the structured fields you need. Captain reads the reply as-is, so free text can contain instructions it might follow.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                | Likely cause                                                                    | What to do                                                                                                            |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Connection failed**                  | Endpoint unreachable, not HTTPS, or wrong credentials                           | Check the URL and credentials; make sure it is public HTTPS                                                           |
| **Connection failed** with 401         | The credentials are wrong                                                       | Check **Authentication Type** and the credentials                                                                     |
| **Connection failed** with 403         | Your API rejected the request                                                   | Test requests carry no contact headers, so an endpoint that needs them fails the test. Test in the Playground instead |
| **Connection failed** with 404         | Wrong URL path                                                                  | Check the URL path                                                                                                    |
| **Connection failed** with a timeout   | Your API took longer than 20 seconds to reply, or 2 seconds to connect          | Speed up the endpoint                                                                                                 |
| URL rejected                           | IP address, localhost or private address                                        | Use a public hostname                                                                                                 |
| A header is rejected                   | It is a header Chatwoot sets itself, a duplicate, or its value has placeholders | Remove it, or move credentials to **Authentication Type**                                                             |
| A tool is missing on another assistant | Tools belong to one assistant                                                   | Switch to that assistant and create the tool there                                                                    |
| Cannot add another tool                | The assistant already has 50 tools                                              | Delete tools it does not use                                                                                          |
| Assistant never uses the tool          | Description is vague                                                            | Rewrite the **Description** to say exactly when to use it                                                             |
| Assistant uses the wrong tool          | Too many tools or overlapping descriptions                                      | Remove or disable tools; make descriptions distinct                                                                   |
| Slow or no answer, then hand-off       | Endpoint took over 20 seconds or returned over 1 MB                             | Speed up the endpoint; trim the response with a Response Template                                                     |
| Captain asks the customer for a code before it uses a tool | The tool requires email verification | This is correct. The customer types the code from their email |
| The customer does not get the code | The customer got 5 codes in the last hour, or the email is in spam | Tell the customer to look in spam, or to wait one hour |
| `X-Chatwoot-Verified-Email` is missing | The customer did not verify, or the verification expired | Turn on **Require email verification**. Captain then asks for a code first |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Work faster with Captain Copilot

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738110272-how-to-use-captain-copilot>

##### Discover

Copilot is an AI helper for agents, inside each conversation. Ask it to summarize, draft a reply, review tone, translate, or look something up.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Any agent can use it, in any inbox. There is nothing to turn on per inbox. Each Copilot request uses Captain credits.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* At least one Captain assistant. Copilot uses an assistant's knowledge when it looks things up. Copilot also searches your help center articles if you have permission to manage the knowledge base. The assistant does not need to be connected to an inbox. For AI that helps agents but never replies to customers, create an assistant and do not connect it to any inbox. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

###### Use Copilot

1. Open a conversation.

2. On the right, open the **Copilot** tab.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSlNPRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--60dd9eefa570251fb7f0756c365bad3988a32f58/captain-8-s1-conversation.png)

3. Pick a starter from **Try these prompts** (**Summarize this conversation**, **Suggest an answer**, **Rate this conversation**), or type your own request. Outside a conversation, Copilot offers **High priority conversations** and **List contacts** instead.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTEdPRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c742bec8b1d87bf0089aed1a9724bbe61e51e78d/captain-8-s2-copilot-tab.png)

4. If you have several assistants, use **Select Assistant** to choose whose knowledge to use.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTjZPRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--315ba6340055e2a4dd65b687b9bec5ca637da958/captain-8-s4-select-assistant.png)

5. When Copilot drafts a reply you like, click **Use this** to put it in the reply box. Edit, then send.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQW1QRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--b13d06357ba1ad3f85446b7a4905c1f88369dfd3/captain-8-s5-drafted.png)

6. Click **Reset** to start over.

###### Test it

Open a real conversation, choose **Suggest an answer**, and check the draft uses your product knowledge.

##### Get value

* Be specific: "Write a polite reply explaining the delay and offering delivery on Friday" works better than "reply".

* Always read a draft before sending. Copilot suggests; the agent decides.

* Use **Show steps** to see how Copilot reached an answer.

* **Suggest an answer** in Copilot uses the selected assistant's full setup: its description, response guidelines, guardrails and FAQs. **Suggest a reply** in the reply editor uses only FAQs (from the inbox's connected assistant, or all approved FAQs in the account), not guidelines or tone.

* Editor actions such as rephrase and summarize are separate AI features.

* To get suggested labels or a priority for a conversation, use **Suggest with Captain** in the conversation sidebar.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                                                              | Likely cause                                           | What to do                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| No Copilot tab                                                                       | Account is on Hacker (free), or Captain is not enabled | See [Get started with Captain AI](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101283-captain-_-introduction) |
| "You are out of Copilot credits. You can buy more credits from the billing section." | No credits left                                        | Buy credits in **Billing**, or wait for renewal                                                        |
| "There was an error generating the response. Please try again."                      | Temporary error                                        | Try again                                                                                              |
| Answers ignore your docs                                                             | Wrong assistant selected, or it has no documents       | Use **Select Assistant**; add documents                                                                |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Use Captain Memories

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101691-how-to-use-captain-memories>

##### Discover

With memories on, the assistant saves key details from a conversation as notes on the contact, so your team, and Copilot, have context next time. The assistant does not read these notes when it replies to customers.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise ([Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing)). An administrator turns it on per assistant.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

###### Turn on memories

1. Go to **Captain** > **Assistants**, open the assistant, and go to **Settings**.

2. Turn on **Capture key details as memories from customer interactions.**

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCR1dRRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--48f2a678cbf9305826f27ced2cabd96f26a7b852/captain-9-m1-settings.png)

3. Save.

###### What gets saved

Details that help next time, such as:

* Preferences, and the products or plan the customer uses.

* Recurring questions or issues.

* Special needs, such as an integration they rely on.

* Context such as team size.

###### Test it

Have a conversation where you mention a preference, for example "We use the Pro plan and prefer email", and resolve it. Then open the contact and check **Notes**.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSnlRRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--570592cebdd5847b2ba3f31aacc59c488a591a5c/captain-9-t1-contact-notes.png)

##### Get value

* Memories appear in the contact's **Notes** with "Bot" as the author and the time they were saved. Agents see them in the conversation sidebar.

* Memories are saved when a conversation in a connected inbox is resolved, whether the assistant or an agent handled it, as long as the account has credits.

* Agents can delete a memory but cannot edit it.

* Tell customers what you store, in line with your privacy policy.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                             | Likely cause                                                                             | What to do                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No notes appear                     | The toggle is off, the conversation is not resolved yet, or nothing worth saving came up | Check the setting; resolve the conversation                                                              |
| Memories stopped                    | Credits ran out                                                                          | See [Captain AI credits and usage](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain) |
| Notes appear for some contacts only | Only resolved conversations in inboxes connected to the assistant create memories        | Expected                                                                                                 |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Captain AI credits and usage

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain>

##### Discover

Captain uses AI credits. Every paid plan includes free credits each month, and you can buy more.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise. How many credits each plan includes, and the top-up price, are on [Pricing & Plans > Captain AI credits](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Administrators see usage and buy credits in **Billing**.

##### Set up & try

###### What uses credits

Each of these uses one credit:

* An assistant reply to a customer.

* A message in the assistant's **Playground**.

* A Copilot request.

* An editor action, such as rephrase, summarize or suggest reply.

* An audio transcription.

* A message translated by auto-translate, when Captain is the translation service.

Adding documents, approving FAQs, label and priority suggestions from **Suggest with Captain**, and Captain conditions in automation rules do not use credits.

###### See your usage

1. Go to **Settings** > **Billing**.

2. The **Captain** section shows **Credits** and **Documents** used. Click **Refresh** to update.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTHFSRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--0ba08ad2f347e23319864d4b36c19942c7e2a160/captain-10-b1-billing.png)

###### Buy more credits

1. In **Billing** > **Captain**, click **Buy more credits**.

2. Choose a pack and click **Purchase Credits**, then confirm. Your saved card is charged straight away.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTnlSRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c0dad65962ebd60bbf4f0dca1c92b463cab27521/captain-10-b2-buy-credits.png)

Bought credits:

* Are added straight away and used after your monthly plan credits.

* Expire after 6 months.

* Need an active subscription to be used.

* Are non-refundable.

###### Test it

After buying, check the new balance in **Billing** > **Captain**.

##### Get value

* Monthly credits reset at your plan's renewal date. Buying credits or changing plan does not reset usage.

* Unused monthly credits do not carry over. If you use more than your monthly credits, the extra comes out of credits you bought.

* When you change plan, your balance goes up or down by the difference between the two plans' monthly credits. Your usage stays the same.

* Changing your number of seats does not reset usage.

* To make credits last: connect the assistant only to inboxes where it helps, use the audience and schedule rules ([Control who Captain replies to and when](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule)), and turn off AI features you do not use, such as transcription.

* A banner warns you when you have used over 80% of your credits. There is no email alert, and credits do not top up automatically.

* Usage is one total for the account. It is not split by agent, assistant or feature. To see how each assistant performs, use its **Overview** ([Captain Overview and reports](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891433-captain-overview-and-reports)).

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                                                                 | Likely cause                                                             | What to do                                                         |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| New conversations go straight to the team with no assistant reply                       | Credits ran out                                                          | Buy credits or wait for renewal                                    |
| Assistant says "Transferring to another agent for further assistance." mid-conversation | Credits ran out during the conversation                                  | Buy credits or wait for renewal                                    |
| Copilot says you are out of Copilot credits                                             | Credits ran out                                                          | Buy credits or wait for renewal                                    |
| Usage did not go to 0 after buying                                                      | Expected. Usage resets only at renewal; the purchase adds to the balance | None                                                               |
| Credits are used faster than expected                                                   | The assistant is on busy inboxes, or AI features are used heavily        | Narrow the audience or schedule; turn off features you do not need |
| Cannot buy credits                                                                      | You are not an administrator, or no active subscription                  | Ask an administrator; check the subscription                       |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).


### Enable Captain on self-hosted

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1755284287-how-to-enable-captain-on-self_hosted-installations>

##### Discover

You can run Captain on your own Chatwoot installation with your own OpenAI key.

Plan & access: included in the Premium and Enterprise self-hosted plans. See [Enterprise Edition](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1677776492-enterprise-edition). You need access to the Super Admin console. The Community Edition does not include Captain.

Premium and Enterprise get the same Captain features and settings.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An OpenAI API key.

* Optional: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint if you host your own model.

* Optional: a Firecrawl API key for better website crawling. Without it, Chatwoot uses a simpler built-in crawler.

###### 1. Configure Captain for the installation

1. Open the Super Admin console and go to Settings.

2. On the Captain card, click the settings (gear) icon.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTUNTRmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--1d6729bca6f354431b1bfb441b4a29c3342c6216/captain-11-c1-settings.png)

3. Fill in:

   * OpenAI API Key.

   * **OpenAI Model** sets the model for Copilot and editor features. Leave it blank to use `gpt-4.1-mini`. The assistant uses `gpt-5.2` by default. To change it, go to **Super Admin › Accounts**, edit the account and open the **Captain models** tab. If you use a custom endpoint, make sure it serves the models you pick here.

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRHJjS3djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--9538b01af339301b438e2cb0830499f6e3289235/captain-11-c3-captain-models.png)

   * OpenAI API Endpoint (optional), for a compatible self-hosted model.

   * Embedding Model (optional).

   * FireCrawl API Key (optional).

     ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQnlURmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a8d96764748a57ed64c523f9c32848f366e35371/captain-11-c2-config-form.png)

4. Click Submit.

###### 2. Turn Captain on for an account

Accounts created while your installation is on Premium or Enterprise have Captain turned on already. For accounts created before that:

1. In the Super Admin console, go to Accounts.

2. Open the account and click Edit.

3. In the premium features, turn on Captain. Guardrails, response guidelines and scenarios come with it. For custom tools, also turn on Custom Tools ([Set up custom tools for Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-\_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain)).

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCSWFURmdjPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--0945b1896b7bbb8e699068ad7a65f0d4beefee18/captain-11-a1-account-edit.png)

4. Save.

###### Test it

Log in to that account. **Captain** appears in the sidebar. Create an assistant and send a message in the **Playground**. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain).

##### Get value

* OpenAI bills you for usage on your own key. Chatwoot does not count Captain credits on self-hosted installations.

* Upgrading from an older version where assistants used the Instructions field? Instructions are no longer used. Move them into guardrails and response guidelines before you upgrade ([Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios)).

* Everything else works as on Cloud. Continue with [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain).

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                        | Likely cause                                                             | What to do                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No Captain in the sidebar      | Not turned on for the account, or not on a Premium or Enterprise licence | Check both steps; check your licence                                                                                                                                               |
| No Tools                       | Custom Tools is off for the account                                      | Turn them on in Super Admin > Accounts                                                                                                                                             |
| Assistant does not reply       | Invalid or inactive OpenAI key, or an unsupported model name             | Check the key. Check your endpoint serves the assistant's model (`gpt-5.2` by default, or the one set in the account's **Captain models** tab).                                    |
| Website documents miss pages   | No Firecrawl key, so the simple crawler is used                          | Add a FireCrawl API Key                                                                                                                                                            |
| Website documents fail to sync | Invalid Firecrawl API key                                                | Check the Firecrawl API key is valid. If a key is set, Chatwoot always uses Firecrawl, so an invalid key makes website documents fail. Remove the key to use the built-in crawler. |
| Still failing                  | An error on the server                                                   | Check the web and worker logs                                                                                                                                                      |


### Troubleshoot Captain

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain>

##### Discover

Use this page when Captain is silent, gives wrong answers, or is not learning. Most problems come from a setting, not a fault.

Plan & access: Captain needs Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) . Most fixes need an administrator.

##### Set up & try: the quick check

When the assistant is silent, check these in order:

1. Plan: is **Captain** in the sidebar? If you see **Upgrade to use Captain AI**, the account is on Hacker (free). Captain is not available during the free trial.

2. Credits: **Settings** > **Billing** > **Captain**. With no credits left, Captain does not run.

3. Inbox: is the inbox listed in the assistant's **Inboxes**?

4. Audience: is it set to **Specific audience**, and does the customer match?

5. Schedule: is it **During business hours** or **Outside business hours**, and does the time match?

6. Timing: rules are checked when a conversation starts or reopens. An ongoing conversation keeps its first decision.

7. Status: Captain replies only while a conversation is **Pending**. If it is **Open**, Captain stays silent. That happens when an agent replied, the assistant handed off, or an automation rule assigned the conversation to someone. Captain does not come back to an open conversation unless it is assigned to the assistant again.

###### Test it

Start a brand new conversation, as a customer who matches the audience, inside the schedule, in a connected inbox.

##### Get value: silent versus failed

* Silent: no reply at all usually means one of the checks above stopped Captain before it started.

* Silent at certain times of day: the schedule follows the inbox's business hours and their time zone. Check the time zone in the inbox settings.

* Handed off: when Captain cannot answer, it sends your **Handoff message** and passes the conversation to your team.

* Out of credits: a new conversation goes straight to your team with no reply. In a conversation Captain is already handling, it sends "Transferring to another agent for further assistance." and passes it on.

##### Troubleshoot

###### Replies

| Symptom                                                                     | Likely cause                                                     | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Assistant never replies                                                     | One of the quick checks                                          | Work through the quick check above                                                                                                                                                           |
| Replies to people you excluded                                              | Their details changed after the conversation started             | Expected; applies from the next conversation. See [Control who Captain replies to and when](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1786119055-control-who-captain-replies-to-and-when-audience-schedule) |
| Replies outside the schedule                                                | Business hours are off for the inbox                             | Turn on business hours in the inbox settings                                                                                                                                                 |
| Wrong or made-up answers                                                    | Missing or outdated knowledge                                    | Add or refresh documents; approve FAQ suggestions. Use **Report Captain message** on the reply to tell Chatwoot what went wrong                                                              |
| Assistant is in a conversation the audience or schedule should have skipped | An agent assigned it to the assistant from the assignee dropdown | Expected. Assign it to a person to take it back                                                                                                                                              |
| Answers off-topic questions                                                 | No guardrails                                                    | Add guardrails. See [Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios)                                      |
| Hands off too often                                                         | Knowledge gaps, or a failing custom tool                         | Review FAQ suggestions; check **Tools**                                                                                                                                                      |
| Conversations resolve too early                                             | **Always resolve** is set with a short wait                      | Choose **Let Captain review it (recommended)** or a longer wait                                                                                                                              |

###### Knowledge

| Symptom                                                     | Likely cause                                                                                                                                        | What to do                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Document shows **Failed to sync**                           | The page needs a login, or your site blocked the request (error 401 or 403). The page may also be missing or slow.                                  | See [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain)                                                                    |
| Added a website but no pages appear, or answers are generic | Your robots.txt may block the crawler.                                                                                                              | Allow the crawler in your robots.txt, then add the document again. See [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain) |
| No FAQ suggestions                                          | **Generate FAQs from resolved conversations** is off. Or no agent replied in the resolved conversations. Suggestions need at least one agent reply. | Turn it on. See [Add FAQs and review FAQ suggestions in Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101609-creating-an-faq-with-captain)                                                      |
| Document limit reached                                      | The account has 2,000 documents across all its assistants                                                                                           | Delete unused documents; see [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing)                                                                                                   |

###### Tools, Copilot and credits

| Symptom                | Likely cause                              | What to do                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Custom tool never used | Vague description, or too many tools      | See [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain)                 |
| Copilot error message  | Temporary error, or out of credits        | Retry; check credits                                                                                     |
| Credits used fast      | Busy inboxes, or AI features used heavily | See [Captain AI credits and usage](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain) |

###### When to contact support

Contact support if the quick check passes and Captain is still silent in a new conversation. Send:

* Your account ID (**Settings** > **Account settings**).

* The assistant's name and the inbox.

* A link to one affected conversation, and the time it happened.

* Whether the assistant replied in the **Playground**.


### Captain Overview and reports

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891433-captain-overview-and-reports>

Back to [Get started with Captain AI](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101283-captain-\_-introduction).

##### Discover

Each assistant has an **Overview** that shows how it is doing: how many conversations it handled, how many it resolved on its own, why it handed off, and how customers rated it.

Plan & access: Startups, Business or Enterprise [Pricing & Plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). Anyone who can open Captain sees the Overview. Only administrators can click a number to see the conversations behind it.

##### Set up & try

###### Before you start

* An assistant connected to an inbox that has handled some conversations. See [Set up a Captain assistant and connect your inboxes](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101547-creating-an-assistant-with-captain). Until an inbox is connected, the Overview shows "This assistant isn't connected to any inbox yet, so it won't respond to conversations."

###### Open the Overview

1. Go to **Captain** and choose the assistant in the assistant switcher.

2. Open **Overview**.

3. Choose the period at the top: a number of days, **This week**, **Last week**, **This month** or **Last month**. The default is **This month**.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQmJlS3djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--1d93b6ed7577326600b9f4ea46afd90859e37dbe/captain-13-o1-overview.png)

###### What each number means

| Number                                  | What it means                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Conversations handled**               | Conversations where Captain replied to the customer or handed the conversation to your team                                     |
| **Auto-resolution rate**                | The share of handled conversations Captain resolved without help from your team. Higher is better                               |
| **Handoff rate**                        | The share of handled conversations Captain passed to your team                                                                  |
| **Reopen rate**                         | The share of Captain-resolved conversations that customers came back to later. Lower is better                                  |
| **Captain resolutions remained closed** | The share of Captain-resolved conversations still closed seven days later. Only resolutions at least seven days old are counted |
| **Median resolution time**              | The typical time from when a conversation reached Captain until it was resolved                                                 |
| **Messages per conversation**           | The average number of replies Captain sent in each conversation it handled                                                      |
| **Saved in agent effort and time**      | An estimate, based on two minutes saved for each public Captain reply                                                           |

###### The other cards

* **Captain summary**: a short written summary of how the assistant is doing. It appears once there is enough activity.

* The flow chart: how handled conversations split into **Resolved by Captain**, **Handed off** and **Closed with team**, and how many Captain resolutions were **Reopened in 7d** or **Stayed closed**.

* **Handoff reasons**: why Captain passed conversations to your team: **Customer requested**, **Missing knowledge**, **Unsupported request**, **Policy restriction**, **Tool failure**, **Pending customer clarification**, **Usage limit** or **Unclassified**.

  ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTVhkS3djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--1023fb2db2bc9370865bf79ed9e14f651cc8afa5/captain-13-o2-flow.png)

* **Resolution trend**: conversations handled and resolved by Captain over the period, compared with the previous period on matching weekdays.

* **Captain CSAT**: the average customer rating for **Captain-resolved conversations** and **Captain-assisted conversations**, compared with conversations your team handled alone.

* **Knowledge coverage**: approved FAQs against **Suggested FAQs** waiting for review. Click **Review FAQs** to go to the queue.

* **Usage**: **Credits** and **Documents** used for the account. Click **Refresh usage** to update, or **Buy more credits**.

###### See the conversations behind a number

Administrators can click a number, or a handoff reason, to see the conversations behind it. Click **Load more** for more.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCT2pkS3djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--210a73e0f9362f91c0eb9b5df3eb5cce7bf4d6bc/captain-13-o3-drilldown.png)

\
The list counts "episodes". A conversation can appear more than once if Captain handled it at separate times, for example after it was reopened.

###### Test it

Choose **This month**, click **Handoff rate**, and open a few conversations. Check that the handoff reasons match what happened.

##### Get value

Use the handoff reasons to decide what to fix first:

| If this is high                                   | Try this                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Missing knowledge**                             | Add documents and approve FAQ suggestions. See [Add documents to Captain's knowledge](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738104411-creating-a-document-in-captain) and [Add FAQs and review FAQ suggestions in Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1738101609-creating-an-faq-with-captain) |
| **Tool failure**                                  | Check your tools. See [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-\_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain)                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Policy restriction** or **Unsupported request** | Check your guardrails and scenarios are not too strict. See [Set Captain's guardrails, guidelines and scenarios](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891414-guardrails-guidelines-and-scenarios)                                                                                                            |
| **Usage limit**                                   | The account ran out of credits. See [Captain AI credits and usage](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1765223602-how-ai-credits-work-in-captain)                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Customer requested**                            | Often expected. If it is very high, check the assistant's answers in the Playground                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

* If **Reopen rate** goes up, answers may look right but not solve the problem. Read some reopened conversations.

* **Saved in agent effort and time** is an estimate, not a measurement.

* For reports across all bots in the account.

##### Troubleshoot

| Symptom                                              | Likely cause                                                           | What to do                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| "No data available for this period."                 | No inbox connected, or Captain handled no conversations in that period | Connect an inbox, or choose another period |
| A period shows "Not enough reporting history yet"    | The assistant has no data that far back                                | Choose a shorter period                    |
| **Captain resolutions remained closed** has no value | No resolution in the period is seven days old yet                      | Expected. Check again later                |
| Clicking a number does nothing                       | You are not an administrator                                           | Ask an administrator                       |
| A conversation appears twice in a list               | Captain handled it in two separate episodes                            | Expected                                   |
| Usage numbers look old                               | The card has not refreshed                                             | Click **Refresh usage**                    |

More causes: [Troubleshoot Captain](https://chatwoot.help/hc/user-guide/articles/1791891431-troubleshoot-captain).

### How to auto-translate messages in a conversation?

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1792447465-auto_translate-conversations>

Auto-translate lets your team support customers in any language. Customer messages appear in your language, and your replies reach the customer in theirs, automatically. This article shows you how to turn it on and how to work with translated conversations.

##### Before you begin

* Auto-translate is available on all paid plans on both self-hosted and Chatwoot Cloud.

* You need to be an **administrator** to turn it on.

* Messages are translated into the language your Chatwoot dashboard is set to. Each agent can change this under **Profile Settings → Preferred Language**. If an agent hasn't picked one, the account's default language is used.

##### Step 1: Turn on Auto-translate

1. Go to **Settings → Conversation Workflows**.

2. In the **Translation** section, choose a translation service:

   * **Captain**: AI translations that sound natural and keep your tone.

   * **Google Translate**: quick, reliable translations from Google. If it shows **Not connected**, click **Connect** and follow the steps first.

3. Turn on the **Auto-translate conversations** toggle.

   ![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCT3JBS2djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--c55fd4268279338642a1d4ab5646b999dc06feb6/01-settings.png?cw_image_width=625px)


*Settings → Conversation Workflows → Translation*

That's it. Auto-translate now works in every conversation in your account. Agents don't need to set anything up.

##### Step 2: Read customer messages in your language

Open any conversation. When a customer writes in another language, their message appears already translated, with a **View original** link underneath that names the language they wrote in.

In the example below, Sophie writes in French and the agent reads her messages in English.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCUG5BS2djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--152ffeb89fc5717aa5ce6c85ca5299e5349ee3a4/02-reading-in-your-language.png?cw_image_width=538px)

*Sophie's French messages appear in English. The agent's English reply is sent to her in French.*

##### Step 3: Reply in your own language

Type your reply in your own language and send it as usual. Chatwoot translates it into the customer's language before it reaches them. A **View translated** link appears under your reply.

##### Step 4: Check the original or translated text

You can always see exactly what was written or sent:

* On a **customer message**, click **View original** to see their exact words.

* On **your reply**, click **View translated** to see the version the customer received.

* Click the link again to switch back.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCQ2JCS2djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--855f8468ebe642120ed9c20efdac9ae40b3b7a05/03-view-original.png?cw_image_width=440px)

*Sophie's original French message, and the French version of the agent's reply*

##### What you'll see on messages

| What you see                                           | What it means                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Purple shimmering text with **Translating…**           | A customer message is being translated into your language. This usually takes a second or two. |
| Purple shimmering text with **Translating to French…** | Your reply is being translated into the customer's language before it's delivered.             |
| **View original (French)**                             | The customer's message was translated. Click to see what they wrote.                           |
| **View translated (French)**                           | Your reply was translated. Click to see what the customer received.                            |
| **Could not translate**                                | A customer message couldn't be translated and is shown as they wrote it.                       |
| **Could not translate, sent as typed**                 | Your reply couldn't be translated, so the customer received your original text.                |


A new customer message is being translated into English

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCR3JCS2djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--51a46f5afc68275132a18bd406b42fb3338095d2/04-customer-message-translating.png?cw_image_width=575px)

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCS25CS2djPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--13595eda965ef126fe476564649b479d5cd90262/05-translating-reply-and-same-language.png?cw_image_width=518px)

*Sophie's English message shows no translation line. The agent's latest reply is being translated to French.*

##### Frequently asked questions

###### How does Chatwoot know which language to reply in?

Chatwoot detects the language the customer is writing in and translates your replies into that language.

###### What happens if the customer switches to my language?

Their messages appear exactly as written, with nothing extra underneath. Your replies follow whatever language the customer is using in the conversation.

###### Are private notes translated?

No. Only messages the customer can see are translated. Private notes stay exactly as you wrote them.

###### Do I still need the Translate option in the message menu?

No. With Auto-translate on, messages are translated for you, so the manual **Translate** option is hidden for those messages.

###### Can I switch between Captain and Google Translate?

Yes. Go back to **Settings → Conversation Workflows** and pick the other service. New messages use the service you choose.


### Install tools from the Captain Tools Catalog

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1792660827-install-tools-from-the-captain-tools-catalog>

The Tools Catalog has ready-made custom tools for services such as Stripe, Cal.com and Attio. You install the tools for a service and enter your credentials. Captain can then use those tools in conversations. Your credentials stay encrypted in your Chatwoot account.

The Tools Catalog is available on the same plans as custom tools. Only administrators can install tools from it.

##### Install tools for a service

1. Go to **Captain** > **Tools**.

2. Use the switcher at the top to choose the assistant.

3. Click **Tools Catalog**.

4. Click a service. The side panel shows its tools, the settings they need and how to get your credentials.

5. Click **Install**.

6. Enter your credentials and settings.

7. Click **Install**.

You can also install from the [Captain Tools](https://www.chatwoot.com/captain/tools) website. Open a service, click **Install in Chatwoot**, and choose the assistant.

##### Manage installed tools

Each installed tool shows under **Captain** > **Tools**. You can turn each tool on or off. You cannot edit the tool.

Some tools read the data of one customer, such as invoices in Stripe. Before these tools run, the customer must verify their email. Administrators can turn this on or off for each tool. See "Protect customer data" in [Set up custom tools for Captain](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1775045339-v2-_-how-to-set-up-custom-tools-for-captain).

Installed tools belong to one assistant. To use them on a different assistant, switch to that assistant and install them again.

Install only the tools that an assistant needs. If tools for two services do similar things, the assistant can choose the wrong one.

##### Update installed tools

When a new version of a service's tools is available, the catalog shows **Update available**. If you deleted one of the tools, the catalog shows **Reinstall**. Both actions keep the on or off setting of each tool. You must enter your secrets again.

##### Build your own

To add tools for a service that you use, see [Publish your tools](https://www.chatwoot.com/captain/tools/publish).

## User Guide — Migrations


### How to migrate from Intercom to Chatwoot?

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1696162098-how-to-migrate-from-intercom-to-chatwoot>

If you are moving from Intercom to Chatwoot, you can use Chatwoot's built-in importer to bring your contacts and past conversations into your Chatwoot account. The import runs in the background, so you can continue setting up Chatwoot while it completes.

> **Availability:** The built-in Intercom importer is available on [Chatwoot paid plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). You must be an account administrator to start and manage an import.

##### What the Intercom import brings over

You can choose to import:

* **Contacts**

* **Conversations**, including their message history and the contacts associated with those conversations

Chatwoot preserves the available source timestamps and source details so the imported records remain useful as historical context.

Imported conversations are added as resolved historical conversations in source-specific Intercom import inboxes. These inboxes preserve history; they do not replace the live channels you will configure in Chatwoot.

##### Before you begin

Make sure that:

* You have a Chatwoot account on a paid plan. If you are new to Chatwoot, [create your account first](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677242820-create-your-chatwoot-account).

* You are an administrator in the Chatwoot account.

* You can create or access a private app in the Intercom workspace you are migrating.

* The Intercom app can read contacts and conversations.

* You have planned your channel cutover. The import is a one-time migration, not a continuous sync.

Only one import (be it Intercom, Freshdesk or others) can run in a Chatwoot account at a time.

##### Step 1: Get an Intercom Access Token

Chatwoot uses an Intercom Access Token to read the data selected for migration.

1. Open the [Intercom Developer Hub](https://app.intercom.io/a/apps/\_/developer-hub/app-packages).

2. Create a private app in the Intercom workspace you want to migrate, or open an existing private app created for the migration.

3. Ensure the app has permission to read contacts and conversations.

4. Open **Configure → Authentication** in the app.

5. Copy the **Access Token**.

For more information, see [Intercom's authentication guide](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/authentication).

> In Chatwoot, the field is labeled **Intercom access key**. Paste the Intercom **Access Token** into this field.

Treat the token like a password. We recommend using a dedicated app for the migration and revoking its token or removing the app after the import has completed and you have verified the results.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTFVYSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--a594a00b07fd27fb86f853ea2963585a996b22ba/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.34.13-E2-80-AFPM.png)


##### Step 2: Open Data settings in Chatwoot

1. Sign in to Chatwoot.

2. Go to **Settings → Data**.

3. Open the **Import** tab.

4. Click **Import**. 

   

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTFlYSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--772fa20652f63b4e97d14dd297e495355f81842b/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.41.27-E2-80-AFPM.png)


##### Step 3: Configure and start the import

In the **New import** dialog:

1. Select **Intercom** as the source.

2. Enter an import name. This helps you identify the migration later.

3. Paste your Intercom Access Token into **Intercom access key**.

4. Under **Data to import**, select one or both of the following:

   * **Contacts** imports contacts from the Intercom workspace.

   * **Conversations** imports past conversations, their messages, and the contacts required for those conversations.

5. Move out of the access-key field and wait for Chatwoot to validate the key.

6. When you see **Access key validated**, click **Import**.

If validation fails, check that you copied the complete token and that the Intercom app has permission to read the data you selected.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTFFYSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--6a6f6d11553ec9858525fe14a2d3459650dbd96a/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.43.00-E2-80-AFPM.png)

##### Step 4: Monitor and verify the import

Chatwoot opens the import details page after the import starts. The page updates automatically while the import runs and shows separate progress for contacts, conversations, and messages.

Depending on the outcome, the import can finish as **Completed** or **Completed with errors**. Review the following before you cut over:

* The imported counts for contacts, conversations, and messages

* A sample of imported contacts and conversations

* The **Errors** section for records Chatwoot could not import

* The **Skip logs** section for records that were intentionally skipped

You can download error and skip logs as CSV files. If an import becomes stalled, use **Retry** when the option appears. You can also abandon an active import if you need to stop it.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCTE1YSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--611f31d5142f38fcd227861ad024c659227a766a/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.45.45-E2-80-AFPM.png)

##### Step 5: Move your live channels to Chatwoot

The data import brings over historical records. It does not recreate your Intercom Messenger or connect it as a live Chatwoot channel.

To move your website chat:

1. [Create a website live chat inbox in Chatwoot](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/website-live-chat).

2. Add the Chatwoot widget code to your website.

3. Remove the Intercom widget code as close as possible to the Chatwoot launch to avoid a gap in coverage.

4. Start a test conversation from your website and confirm that it reaches the correct Chatwoot inbox and team.

If you use other Intercom channels, set up the corresponding [Chatwoot channels](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/other-channels) and test each one before completing the cutover.

##### Important behavior and limitations

* The import is a one-time historical migration. New changes in Intercom are not continuously synced to Chatwoot.

* Historical imports do not send messages or notifications to your customers.

* Imported conversations are resolved and stored in source-specific import inboxes. Configure new Chatwoot inboxes for ongoing customer communication.

* File attachments are not transferred. When an Intercom message has attachments, Chatwoot adds a note to the message indicating how many attachments were skipped.

* Intercom teammates, teams, assignments, routing rules, automations, apps, and Messenger settings are not recreated in Chatwoot.

* Some source-specific fields are retained as metadata but may not appear as equivalent Chatwoot fields.

* Keep access to Intercom until you have reviewed the imported counts, sample records, and any error or skip logs.

##### Make Chatwoot your own

Once the import and channel cutover are complete, these resources will help your team get started:

* [Chatwoot 101 tutorials](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/chatwoot-101)

* [Set up an omnichannel inbox](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/other-channels)

* [Chatwoot best practices](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/best-practices)

For anything else, reach out to us through the support chat. Happy chatting!


### How to migrate from Front to Chatwoot?

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1696163019-how-to-migrate-from-front-to-chatwoot>

If you're currently using Front and want to switch to Chatwoot, this guide will walk you through the step-by-step process of migrating your conversations, contacts, live chat widget, and setting up Chatwoot. This is a very quick process; let’s dive in.

##### Before you begin

Before setting up Chatwoot, there are two essential preliminary tasks to complete in order to smoothly remove Front from your ecosystem.

###### **Step 1.** Remove the Front chat widget

To start, please make sure to uninstall the existing live chat code that you would have previously integrated for enabling the Front live chat widget on your website.

###### **Step 2.** Export contacts

Next, export all of your contacts from Front, with the help of [this guide](https://help.front.com/en/articles/2058#exporting_contacts).

##### Migrating to Chatwoot

###### **Step 3.** Sign up

Create an account in Chatwoot, using [this guide](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677242820-create-your-chatwoot-account).

###### **Step 4.** Migrate the live chat widget

Create a live chat inbox in Chatwoot, using [this guide](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/website-live-chat). At the end of the setup, you will find the live chat code snippet to be pasted into your website’s codebase. Complete this step, ensuring that you have already removed the live chat code snippet for Front’s live chat widget, as mentioned in Step 1.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBd3VsY3c9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--fd776959af89b42f99042465ad68f5af7b2a8344/chatwoot-messenger-snippet.jpg)

###### **Step 5.** Migrate contacts

Open the ‘Contacts’ tab in Chatwoot, press the Import button.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdzJsY3c9PSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--e5c17eaa35795e86a803395ff66e4afd1dbf4797/importing-contacts-in-chatwoot.jpg)

Next, follow the on-screen instructions to upload the Contacts file exported from Front, in a `csv` format. Once your upload is completed, all of your contacts will be successfully synced in Chatwoot.

###### **Step 6.** Migrate conversations

For importing your existing conversations from Front to Chatwoot, use [this API](https://www.chatwoot.com/developers/api/#tag/Conversations/operation/newConversation).

###### **Step 7.** Make Chatwoot your own

You are all set to use Chatwoot, congratulations! We recommend the following steps to begin making the best of Chatwoot:

[Chatwoot 101 tutorials](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/chatwoot-101): A comprehensive guide to learn the basics of Chatwoot within minutes.

[Omnichannel inbox](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/other-channels): A helping hand to setting up your omnichannel customer service on Chatwoot.

A few [best practices](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/best-practices) to make your workflow smooth as butter on Chatwoot.

For everything else, hit us up on `hello@chatwoot.com`, and don't forget to share your feedback with us. Happy chatting!


### How to migrate from Freshdesk to Chatwoot?

> Fuente: <https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1696159781-how-to-migrate-from-freshdesk-to-chatwoot>

If you are moving from Freshdesk to Chatwoot, you can use Chatwoot's built-in importer to bring your contacts and past tickets into your Chatwoot account. The import runs in the background, so you can continue setting up Chatwoot while it completes.

> **Availability:** The built-in Freshdesk importer is available on [Chatwoot paid plans](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing). You must be an account administrator to start and manage an import.

##### What the Freshdesk import brings over

You can choose to import:

* **Contacts**

* **Conversations**, which imports Freshdesk tickets, their replies and private notes, and the contacts associated with those tickets

Chatwoot preserves the available source timestamps and source details so the imported records remain useful as historical context.

Imported tickets are added as resolved historical conversations in source-specific Freshdesk import inboxes. These inboxes preserve history; they do not replace the live channels you will configure in Chatwoot.

##### Before you begin

Make sure that:

* You have a Chatwoot account on a paid plan. If you are new to Chatwoot, [create your account first](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/articles/1677242820-create-your-chatwoot-account).

* You are an administrator in the Chatwoot account.

* You know your original Freshdesk domain, such as `acme.freshdesk.com`. Use the Freshdesk domain, not a custom support-portal domain.

* You have an API key from a verified Freshdesk agent with access to the contacts and tickets you want to migrate. We recommend using an administrator's API key so the import can read the complete available history.

* You have planned your channel cutover. The import is a one-time migration, not a continuous sync.

Only one Intercom or Freshdesk integration import can run in a Chatwoot account at a time.

> **Freshdesk ticket limit:** Freshdesk's List All Tickets API returns a maximum of 300 pages, or 30,000 tickets. If your account has 30,000 or more tickets, Chatwoot stops the import when the API can no longer confirm that the history is complete. The remaining history requires a Freshdesk Account Export, which the built-in importer does not currently support.

##### Step 1: Get your Freshdesk domain and API key

Your Freshdesk domain is the hostname you use to open Freshdesk. For example, if you sign in at [`https://acme.freshdesk.com`](https://acme.freshdesk.com), enter `acme.freshdesk.com` in Chatwoot.

To find your API key:

1. Sign in to Freshdesk as the verified agent whose API access you will use.

2. Click your profile picture in the upper-right corner.

3. Select **Profile Settings**.

4. In the right pane, click **View API key**.

5. Complete Freshdesk's CAPTCHA verification and copy the API key.

For more information, see [Freshdesk's guide to finding your API key](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/215517-how-to-find-your-api-key).

Treat the API key like a password. Freshdesk lets you reset the key after the migration, but resetting it also disconnects every other app that uses the same key. Check for other integrations before you reset it.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRnNlSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--7c8e326d6d63c3f712f1bcd5043fdd5a8b15f559/1m5KxTsiR2NrQuG4IVMC5uUuh-Dleox7hQ.jpg)

##### Step 2: Open Data settings in Chatwoot

1. Sign in to Chatwoot.

2. Go to **Settings → Data**.

3. Open the **Import** tab.

4. Click **Import**.

   

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRjBlSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--75b070f2b4c02b8e2192328a5cb17956355c47c8/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.41.27-E2-80-AFPM.png)

##### Step 3: Configure and start the import

In the **New import** dialog:

1. Select **Freshdesk** as the source.

2. Enter an import name. This helps you identify the migration later.

3. Enter your **Freshdesk domain**, for example `acme.freshdesk.com`.

4. Paste your key into **Freshdesk API key**.

5. Under **Data to import**, select one or both of the following:

   * **Contacts** imports contacts from Freshdesk.

   * **Conversations** imports tickets, their replies and notes, and the contacts required for those tickets.

6. Move out of the API-key field and wait for Chatwoot to validate the credentials.

7. When you see **Access key validated**, click **Import**.

If validation fails, check the domain, confirm that you copied the complete API key, and verify that the Freshdesk agent's role can read the selected data.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRndlSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--12c9f5713a3f1d3afc0538ada0d0f6baba09cf41/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-202.57.16-E2-80-AFPM.png)


##### Step 4: Monitor and verify the import

Chatwoot opens the import details page after the import starts. The page updates automatically while the import runs and shows separate progress for contacts, conversations, and messages.

Freshdesk applies API rate limits based on your Freshdesk plan. Chatwoot waits and retries when Freshdesk asks it to slow down, so large imports can take time.

Depending on the outcome, the import can finish as **Completed** or **Completed with errors**. Review the following before you cut over:

* The imported counts for contacts, conversations, and messages

* A sample of imported contacts and tickets

* The **Errors** section for records Chatwoot could not import

* The **Skip logs** section for records that were intentionally skipped

You can download error and skip logs as CSV files. If an import becomes stalled, use **Retry** when the option appears. You can also abandon an active import if you need to stop it.

![](https://app.chatwoot.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBCRm9lSFFZPSIsImV4cCI6bnVsbCwicHVyIjoiYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--4e0112f408cbc82aa8a2262a2bdd242de936c4a0/Screenshot-202026-08-07-20at-203.01.22-E2-80-AFPM.png)

##### Step 5: Move your live channels to Chatwoot

The data import brings over historical records. It does not recreate your Freshdesk widget or connect it as a live Chatwoot channel.

To move your website chat:

1. [Create a website live chat inbox in Chatwoot](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/website-live-chat).

2. Add the Chatwoot widget code to your website.

3. Remove the Freshdesk widget code as close as possible to the Chatwoot launch to avoid a gap in coverage.

4. Start a test conversation from your website and confirm that it reaches the correct Chatwoot inbox and team.

If you use other Freshdesk channels, set up the corresponding [Chatwoot channels](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/other-channels) and test each one before completing the cutover.

##### Important behaviour and limitations

* The import is a one-time historical migration. New changes in Freshdesk are not continuously synced to Chatwoot.

* Historical imports do not send messages or notifications to your customers.

* Imported conversations are resolved and stored in source-specific import inboxes. Configure new Chatwoot inboxes for ongoing customer communication.

* File attachments are not transferred. When a Freshdesk message has attachments, Chatwoot adds a note to the message indicating how many attachments were skipped.

* Freshdesk agents, groups, assignments, routing rules, automations, apps, SLAs, and widget settings are not recreated in Chatwoot.

* Deleted and spam tickets are not returned by Freshdesk's List All Tickets API and are not included in the import.

* Freshdesk limits that API to [300 pages, or 30,000 tickets](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#list_all_tickets). The importer cannot currently ingest the separate Freshdesk Account Export required for any remaining history.

* Some source-specific fields are retained as metadata but may not appear as equivalent Chatwoot fields.

* Keep access to Freshdesk until you have reviewed the imported counts, sample records, and any error or skip logs.

##### Make Chatwoot your own

Once the import and channel cutover are complete, these resources will help your team get started:

* [Chatwoot 101 tutorials](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/chatwoot-101)

* [Set up an omnichannel inbox](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/other-channels)

* [Chatwoot best practices](https://www.chatwoot.com/hc/user-guide/en/categories/best-practices)

For anything else, reach out to us through the support chat. Happy chatting!
